text:
Maya (GTM): FYI — CloudWave agreed to a joint marketplace listing + webinar. They want a tight timeline to capture their Q2 demand. Proposed schedule below, please flag issues by EOD.

Ethan (Partnerships): Love it. Confirmed partner speakers: Lina (CloudWave PM), Rahul (Eng). We can get a partner case study slide. Need session brief.

Kai (Content): Draft webinar page + blog outline — will share today. For blog: benchmark narrative vs native cloud provider latency and cost profiles, and a customer spotlight. Need partner quotes.

Zoe (Demand): For inbound routing — want marketplace signups + webinar registrants to hit 'MW-ENGAGE' campaign in SFDC. Quick conversion path: marketplace -> webhook -> zapier -> SFDC queue. Prefer direct webhook if possible.

Sam (Analytics): We'll need UTM params from the listing and registration link. Also want to track 'listing_impression' event. I can add dashboard tile.

Maya (GTM): Proposed timeline:
- 2026-04-15: Listing goes live
- 2026-04-18: Blog + benchmark post
- 2026-04-21: Joint webinar (11am PT)
- 2026-04-28: Follow-up recirculation

Ethan (Partnerships): Can we move listing to 4/13? Their marketplace slot opens earlier.

Maya (GTM): 4/13 ok if legal and marketplace QA signoff. Kai, can you compress the blog draft schedule?

Kai (Content): I can drop draft by 4/14 AM. Will include hero metric callouts and a 2-paragraph executive summary for social.

Zoe (Demand): Routing rules (draft):
```
source: cloudwave_marketplace
campaign: mw-integration-q2
route:
  - type: webinar_reg
    to: SFDC_Campaign 'MW-WEBINAR'
  - type: marketplace_click
    to: SFDC_Queue 'MW-INBOUND' owner: 'Ethan'
```
We should also ensure partners' leads are tagged with 'partner=cloudwave'.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing status changed -> QA required by 2026-04-11

Ethan (Partnerships): I'll own the partner lead handoff doc and add partner contact fields (company, sso_needed, use_case). Will post link.

Sam (Analytics): Also recommend adding a short eval prompt in webinar registration to capture workload type (chat, retrieval, embeddings). Helps Optimize recommendations later.

Maya (GTM): Action items:
- Ethan: partner contact + lead handoff doc (due 2026-04-10)
- Kai: blog + webinar page draft (due 2026-04-14)
- Zoe: implement routing, test webhook -> SFDC (due 2026-04-12)
- Sam: tracking dashboard and registration fields (due 2026-04-13)
- Marketplace-bot / Legal: QA + TOS check (due 2026-04-11)

Maya (GTM): If no blockers, I'll lock dates by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

Ethan (Partnerships): 👍 I'll follow up with Lina for quote.

Kai (Content): Will post draft links here when ready.

Zoe (Demand): I'll set up a quick test registration this afternoon and report back.

Sam (Analytics): I'll scaffold the dashboard and share a GIF of the events mapping.

Maya (GTM): Thanks team — syncing with Product tomorrow to confirm demo env. If anything urgent ping me @Maya
